scope: Synthetic local probes only; no third-party execution, installation, sudo, services, production or health payloads

tools.discovery_command: command -v for bwrap unshare podman docker firejail timeout prlimit systemd-run; later setpriv and nsenter

result.qualification_reason: A child namespace does not constrain model or host tools.

resource_controls.systemd_scope: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=64M --quiet sh -c cat /proc/self/cgroup started; enforcement not tested

decision.rootless_process_capability: A private bind mask hid the synthetic pathname in the child namespace; host file still visible and host canary readable
decision.model_tool_boundary: not established; current agent retains host tools under same Unix authority
decision.alternatives: Fresh constrained API executor with allowlisted broker and no host tools plus verified minimal rootless namespace, or separately scoped VM; either needs independent boundary and resource-control testing
